name: 800G XDR single-mode DR4 optics link (half of NVIDIA MMS4A00 1.6T twin-port)
description: One 800 Gb/s XDR port (4 x 200G-PAM4) of the 1.6T twin-port 2xDR4 OSFP transceiver used in Q3400 cages (2 x 800G per cage). 500 m over MPO-12/APC single-mode. Power per 800G end is half the module.

power_per_end_w.note: 33.5 W max per 1.6T twin-port module / 2 ports

weight_kg_per_m.note: one 12-fiber MPO jumper per 800G DR4 port at 8.3 g/m (Neutrik 3.0 mm cable)

sources.title: Neutrik opticalCON MTP patch and breakout cable datasheet (12-fiber 3.0 mm cable weight)
